title: ポリスノーツ
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
The kanji read off the game's font in main memory: a second reader (manga-ocr) and the font's JIS order together, then by eye and in sentences of the disc's own text
Played from power-on through the first room's objects; the script's readings compared with the lines read off 16 pictures, and its lines elsewhere in the room with pictures taken as it went
notes: Read by the script games/ps1/SLPS-00215.lua; there is no layout. The two discs share one boot executable. Two bytes a character, high byte first; only the low 13 bits say which character. Kana and ASCII by a rule, signs and kanji by the table, which was read off the game's font in main memory (JIS order). The window's messages are said a page at a time, and the lines of spoken passages as each shows. Who speaks, the picture's commands, the title's messages and the opening film's lines aren't read.
